author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Claude AI step-by-step to actually get real work done.

In this complete tutorial, you’ll start with the basics like writing emails and summarizing documents, then move into powerful features like artifacts, projects, connectors, and skills.

By the end, you’ll know how to go beyond simple prompts and use Claude as a true productivity tool.

Whether you're a beginner or looking to go deeper, this guide will help you get the most out of Claude AI.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Learn how to use Claude Skills: https://youtu.be/wO8EboopboU

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Introduction
0:33 - Open Claude and explore the interface
1:04 - Write a professional email
2:21 - Upload files and summarize content
3:18 - Introduce artifacts and create documents
5:23  - Organize work with projects
7:25 - Connect Claude to other tools
7:57 - Use skills for reusable workflows
8:21 - Wrap up and next steps
